goal: Close cross-application reads through CRM definer-semantics views (issue 2662 batch 1) while keeping identical rows for every CRM, PopDAM, PIM, DesignFlow and Data Admin caller.
prohibited_actions: No direct production DDL; production only through the governed workflow.
Do not change view columns, grants or comments.
Do not touch views owned by other active claims (api.db_data_admin_scraped_properties, api.pim_item_picker, api.plm_item_list).
assumptions: All app consumers of the changed views read as the authenticated role from popcrm-web; no service-role consumer exists.
Parent owns preview, merge, production and live acceptance.
Preview authenticated-role parity per identity runs after merge through the orchestrator-held preview dispatch; the pre-apply preview baseline is recorded in PR 2764.
stop_conditions: Stop if any CRM-access caller's row count changes on preview.
Stop if a PopDAM, PIM, DesignFlow or Data Admin consumer of a changed view is found.
